1.title: Five injured, one critically, in shooting at Virginia State University
1.summary: Multiple suspects were involved in the incident in the early hours of Saturday, the university said.

2.title: Sherrod Brown Seeks Senate Comeback in Ohio, Hoping His Populist Pitch Still Resonates
2.summary: At 73, Sherrod Brown is mounting a comeback bid in Ohio. He is one of the Democrats his party is counting on to retake control of the Senate.

3.title: What Is Happening at the Border in Big Bend National Park?
3.summary: Over the objections of environmentalists, local sheriffs and some state leaders, the Trump administration appears to be moving ahead with border infrastructure in one of Texas’ most beloved parks.

5.title: Canadian Petition to Expel U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra Takes Off
5.summary: Mr. Hoekstra has been President Trump’s faithful messenger in Canada amid a historic low in relations. More than 170,000 Canadians want him gone.

6.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
6.summary: Lee Jae Myung offers chance to end the conflict, which has been frozen since an armistice in 1953.
